# VentureCite — Complete User-Facing Copy (UX Copy Inventory)

> **Historical snapshot.** This stale document is redacted. It does not give current guidance.

Every text string a user can see anywhere in the product — web app, emails, and
server-rendered pages — extracted **verbatim** from the source. Organized by
page/screen, each with a table of the exact text, its type, where it appears, and
when it shows up.

This was compiled by reading every page, component, hook, email template, and
user-facing server response in the codebase. Dynamic values are shown as
`{placeholder}`. Pipes inside a string are escaped as `\|`; multi-line strings use
`<br>`.

## How to read the tables

| Column               | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Text**             | The exact string, verbatim (with `{dynamic}` placeholders).                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Type**             | What kind of copy: heading, body, button, label, placeholder, helper, tooltip, toast-success, toast-error, validation, empty-state, loading, error, dialog, badge, tab, status, menu-item, marketing, legal, subject (email), etc. |
| **Where it appears** | The screen region / component / email section.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **When it shows**    | The trigger or condition (always, on an action, on error, while loading, when a list is empty, a specific state, etc.).                                                                                                            |

## Contents

1. Authentication & Marketing pages (login, register, password, verify, welcome, setup, 404, landing, pricing, privacy, glossary)
2. App shell & shared components (sidebar, nav, command palette, dialogs, chatbot, error boundary, toasts)
3. Onboarding checklist (single-source copy shown in sidebar + dashboard)
4. Brand & Content pages (brands, articles, content generation, FAQ, keywords, competitors, community)
5. Visibility & Diagnose pages (AI visibility, citations, geo-signals, geo-tools, crawler check, diagnose, monitor, report, act + their components)
6. Fact Sheet, Home, Settings & Admin (+ fact-sheet / intelligence / foundations components)
7. Emails & server-side messages (weekly report, digest, welcome, unsubscribe pages, auth/account/billing errors, password policy, shared labels)

> **Notes on scope:** screen-reader text (`aria-label`, `sr-only`, `title`) is
> included because it is user-facing UX copy. `data-testid` values and purely
> decorative/hidden attributes are excluded. A few server error responses fall
> back to raw upstream messages (Supabase/GoTrue/Stripe) rather than a hardcoded
> string — these are flagged inline in section 7. Landing-page mock-UI sample
> text is tagged `(mock)`.

| Email is required                                                                       | error   | POST /api/auth/forgot-password & /api/auth/resend-verification (400)                       | When email missing                                             |

## Engine — Navigation Buttons & Fallback Copy (engine/shepherdAdapter.ts, engine/copyResolver.ts)

Rendered on every tour/nudge popover footer by the Shepherd adapter. Button visibility is conditional (see "When it shows").

| Text                  | Type                              | Where it appears                                | When it shows                                                                                       |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Back                  | tour-button                       | Popover footer, secondary button                | Shown on every step except the first (`index > 0`)                                                  |
| Skip                  | tour-button                       | Popover footer, secondary button                | Shown on non-final steps when `showSkip !== false`; persists a skip and cancels the tour            |
| Don't show again      | tour-button (`tour-skip-forever`) | Popover footer, left-aligned tertiary text link | Shown only in auto-fired mode when `showSkipForever !== false`; suppresses the tour permanently     |
| Next                  | tour-button                       | Popover footer, primary button                  | Shown on every non-final step (advances to next step)                                               |
| Done                  | tour-button                       | Popover footer, primary button                  | Shown on the final step (index === last); completes the tour                                        |
| (content unavailable) | label (fallback)                  | Any step title or body                          | Fallback rendered by copyResolver when a step's copy is undefined/null/empty or its function throws |

It surfaced these genuine additions — chiefly the literal SERVER response/validation messages that fill client toasts (the UI shows `{error.message}`; these are the actual texts), plus a few alt-text / aria-label / relative-time-formatter strings._

## 12a. Server response & validation messages (fill client toasts)

# UX Copy Gap Audit — Batch 8

Scope: `server/emailService.ts`, `server/lib/welcomeEmail.ts`, `server/routes/unsubscribe.ts`, `server/lib/notificationPrefs.ts`, `shared/constants.ts`, `shared/passwordPolicy.ts`, `shared/validateDomain.ts`, `shared/industries.ts`, `shared/factCategories.ts`, plus a scan for user-facing `{error}`/`{message}` strings in `server/auth.ts`, `server/routes/userAccount.ts`, `server/routes/billing.ts`, `server/routes/brands.ts`, `server/routes/content.ts`, `server/routes/prompts.ts`, `server/routes/mentions.ts`, `server/routes/geoSignals.ts`, `server/routes/factSheet.ts`, `server/routes/factSheetV2.ts`.

The first nine files (and `auth.ts` / `userAccount.ts` / `billing.ts`) are **fully documented already** in `UX-COPY.md` (dedicated sections: "Email — Weekly Visibility Report", "Email — Weekly Digest", "Email — Welcome", "Page — Unsubscribe", "Auth error / response messages", "Account & billing messages", "Password policy", "Domain validation", "Shared constants / labels", "Industries", "Fact Categories", "Notification types"). Every candidate string enumerated from those files was verified present verbatim. No gaps found there.

Gaps exist in the route files that own AI/content/prompts/mentions/fact-sheet/geo-signals server error strings — UX-COPY.md documents the _client-side_ toast wrappers for these pages (generic titles, or `{error.message}` interpolation placeholders) but not the literal server response text that fills them.
